title: MIMOS-Tools: An Integrated Toolchain for Model-Based Design of Embedded Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.27826v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite decades of progress in model-based methods and tools for embedded real-time systems, there is still no integrated environment that supports the entire development lifecycle. This paper presents MIMOS-Tools, a comprehensive toolchain spanning the key phases of development, including modeling, simulation, formal verification, real-time scheduling, schedulability and end-to-end latency analysis, and code generation for heterogeneous multicore platforms. All phases are grounded in a single, coherent, and deterministic model of computation, the MIMOS model, for which we present a formal operational semantics and establish both functional and timing determinism. This semantic foundation ensures that properties verified at the model level are preserved throughout the development process and in the generated implementation. translated_title: MIMOS-Tools：面向嵌入式系统基于模型设计的集成工具链
translated_abstract: 尽管基于模型的方法和工具在嵌入式实时系统领域已经发展了几十年，但至今仍没有一个能够支持完整开发生命周期的集成环境。本文提出了MIMOS-Tools，这是一个覆盖开发关键阶段的综合性工具链，包括建模、仿真、形式化验证、实时调度、可调度性与端到端延迟分析，以及面向异构多核平台的代码生成。所有阶段均建立在一个单一、连贯且确定性的计算模型——MIMOS模型之上，本文为其提出了形式化操作语义，并证明了其功能确定性与时间确定性。这一语义基础确保了在模型层面验证的性质能够在整个开发过程及最终生成的实现中得以保持。MIMOS-Tools的一个显著特点是其不仅支持确定性，还支持模块化、可组合的……
tldr: 该论文提出了MIMOS-Tools集成工具链，基于具有形式化操作语义和功能与时间确定性的MIMOS计算模型，为嵌入式实时系统提供从建模、仿真、形式化验证到异构多核平台代码生成的全生命周期一体化支持。
en_tdlr: This paper presents MIMOS-Tools, an integrated toolchain supporting the full development lifecycle of embedded real-time systems—from modeling, simulation, and formal verification to code generation for heterogeneous multicore platforms—all grounded in a single deterministic model of computation (MIMOS) with formal operational semantics ensuring that verified properties are preserved through to the generated implementation.
